Raised $5M+ from Y Combinator (W17), Two Bear Capital, CabraVC, and top angel investors. Contributed to combating human trafficking, featured in Business Insider.

description: At-Home health monitoring with silicon photonic chips for data centers

founders.name: Michael Dubrovsky
founders.bio: I'm a serial entrepreneur interested in challenging myself and changing the world with nanotechnology.

founders.name: Diedrik Vermeulen
founders.bio: Diedrik is one of the founders of SiPhox and serves as its Chief Executive Officer. Diedrik brings to SiPhox extensive expertise and experience in the development of optical systems on a chip. Prior to joining SiPhox, Diedrik was the director of engineering at Analog Photonics and a research scientist at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Diedrik has 28 patents and 108 publications and is recognized as the world expert in optical fiber, free-space and chip-to-chip coupling.

name: PeakPath

founders.name: Shane Correa
founders.bio: Authentic, positive, and driven to serve, Shane is an accomplished team-builder and leader who is on a mission to make a positive impact on the world. Hailing from NYC, with 15+ years working internationally, he has used technology to inspire digital transformations. He combines experience from both the SMB and enterprise spaces across European and US markets. Shane has repeatedly built highly successful B2B SaaS companies "from the ground up" including two PE exits, one of which was at $100M.

founders.name: Kerstin Jeding
founders.bio: I am a psychologist who have worked in research into stress, the social work environment, sleep, health and turnover intent, as well as clinically. I have been part of running a specialist clinic rehabilitating persons with (work) stress related exhaustion/clinical burnout, and I have treated early stress warning signs with ACT and CBT therapy. I also have worked in stress prevention, in applied research projects, by giving workshops and lectures, and publishing self-help books.

founders.name: Javier Ubillos
founders.bio: Javier Ubillos is a product developer with a background in distributed systems research. He's founded NudgeLabs, who aims to help people manage the stress in their life and making their wellbeing something easy to achieve.

founders.name: Arav Mathur
founders.bio: Founder/CEO at GrayPass (YC F26). University of Waterloo CS. Founded my first startup at 15, $30K raised with 1.7k users. Launched a fashion app with 4.3K weekly active users that generated 1M+ views on social media. Served as the sole growth engineer at Stan ($40M ARR). At 16, developed dubbing and translation tools for creators including Logan Paul, Yes Theory and GothamChess. Now building GrayPass to help apps stop people and AI agents from taking sensitive actions without permission.

founders.name: Aditya Ranjan
founders.bio: Founder/COO @ GrayPass (YC F26) | Making human agency legible. Previously studied Neuroscience @ McGill. Conducted neurosurgical research at SickKids, with work published in Springer Nature. Granted a fellowship @ UBC to develop longitudinal transformer models predicting epilepsy outcomes from MRI scans. Founded an organization developing seizure-detection technology for epilepsy applications. Created brain tumour segmentation algorithms for UPenn BraTS challenges alongside EPFL researchers.
